### New in 1.7.5
- **Explore is shared.** A post you write shows up for other people using Shelfwise.
- **Pick your words** has more lines and words for writing a post.
- **A real shelf starts empty.** The sample library is unchanged. Turning the sample library off no longer adds Reading now, Want to read, and Favourites.
- **Long titles.** After a barcode scan, a long title no longer blocks **Add to my shelf**.
- The Home button that scanned a share QR is gone. Barcode scan on **Add a book** stays. The share bag can still make a QR picture you can send or save.

### Updating from 1.7.3 or older (one time only)
Shelfwise 1.7.4 and later use a new signing key, so Android may say **"App not installed as package conflicts with an existing package"**. If it does:
1. In Shelfwise, open **Settings → Backup & restore**. Turn on **Include book files** to keep your PDFs and EPUBs, then tap **Share backup** and save the file somewhere safe (Drive, Files…).
2. Uninstall Shelfwise, then install `shelfwise.apk` from below.
3. Open **Settings → Backup & restore → Import backup**.

If you already installed 1.7.4, this update installs over the top and keeps your data.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it.
